self_assessment: Extracted the device metadata rendering out of DeviceTile into a new DeviceMetaData component (src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceMetaData.tsx) that keeps the ' . ' separators, the mx_DeviceTile_inactiveIcon hook and the data-testid=device-metadata-<id> ids (inactive|isVerified|lastActivity|lastSeenIp|deviceId), applies the inactive rule (badge + IP only, suppressing verification and last activity, and only when last_seen_ts exists) and the ~6-day short-date vs relative-time formatting. Added src/utils/device/isDeviceVerified.ts which centralises the cross-signing lookup, returning null instead of throwing when the user id, cross-signing info or stored device is missing; DevicesPanel now delegates to it and no longer stores crossSigningInfo in state (the CrossSigningInfo import and the inline trust method are gone). DeviceTile renders <DeviceMetaData/>. UnverifiedSessionToast became .tsx and embeds DeviceMetaData as its detail, normalising the raw IMyDevice into an ExtendedDevice with isVerified from the helper and a safe DeviceType.Unknown; the buttons are now 'Yes, it was me' (dismiss only) and 'No' (dismiss then dispatch ViewUserDeviceSettings), with the title unchanged. Added the new i18n string and removed the now-unused 'Check your devices' (I initially also removed '%(deviceId)s from %(ip)s' and restored it after finding VerificationRequestToast still uses it). Verified per-file with tsc: only missing-node_modules resolution errors remain, no semantic ones. Jest could not run - the proxy blocks codeload.github.com so yarn install fails.
